articles.body:
Sorry for being daft- but I am really struggling to understand the rules of what happens when an invasion crisis happens against the company.

In my solo game, I have Maratha (2 towers, no flag) invading Bombay (company controlled, 1 unrest, 1 tower, no officers, regiments, or local alliances). There is no other unrest on the board.

Rules say I do an invasion first- which I believe results in a new empire?  Although it doesn't seem to say I remove my governorship or what happens to them?  

Then my assumption that any other spaces on the board have a rebellion- although I have none- but wanted to confirm this is regardless of company ownership of spaces or not.

Just need this slow walked for me.  Thanks in advance!

articles.body:
check page 33 of the rules

[i]Mounting Defence. The Commander associated with the region
must exhaust pieces in the Army equal to the strength of the Crisis
or as many as possible. If the newly-exhausted pieces do not equal
the strength of the Crisis, the Crisis succeeds. Perform the steps of
Region Loss (page 29).

If the attack failed, remove all unrest in the attacked region and the
Commander associated with the region should take a trophy token.
¼ Failed and Successful Invasions. If the primary Crisis was an
Invasion that failed, remove one tower level from the attacking
region if possible. If it was successful follow the rules of empire
creation and growth as described on the previous page. [/i]

In short you execute region loss and then the marathas get empire growth when they beat you as a result of you having no officers/regiments and mercs. The if there were other spaces with unrest they would rebel

[i]ATTACKS AGAINST THE COMPANY

Both Invasions and Rebellions against Company-controlled regions are
resolved the same way. Whenever attacked by any type of Crisis, the
Company must resolve the Crisis (called the primary Crisis) and then must
resolve an additional Rebellion Crisis in each other region with unrest
cubes using the following rules:

Order of Resolution. Always resolve the primary Crisis first. Then,
starting with the Commander of the Army of Bombay and proceeding
downwards, each Commander resolves attacks in regions associated
with their Presidency in any order. [/i]

articles.body:
I can spot a couple places where you might be confused.
[q="lelechuck"]Bombay (company controlled, 1 unrest, 1 tower, no officers, regiments, or local alliances). [/q]
A company-controlled region shouldn't have any dome/tower.  When the company takes over a region, you replace the dome (and any tower levels) with the governor overlay.

[q]Then my assumption that any other spaces on the board have a rebellion- although I have none- but wanted to confirm this is regardless of company ownership of spaces or not.[/q]
I think you're talking about Unrest cubes here -- a region that isn't company-controlled can't have any unrest cubes. You remove the cubes from a region if the company loses it. Read page 29 for all the steps of region loss.
